entities.name: Provinciaal Archeologisch Museum Velzeke
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The archaeological museum of Velzeke is a museum located on the Paddestraat in Velzeke-Ruddershove in Zottegem, Belgium. It focuses on prehistorical times and the Gallo-Roman period. The museum opened its doors in 1972.
